approach: Run the decision gate inside producer_loop (producer.rs), sharing the one-send-back budget with unmet criteria. A shared builder in checks.rs takes a "read the candidate's file" closure and returns Result<Option<String>, String>, where Err means the base list is unreadable. The commit-based entry point keeps today's signature and is the only caller that prints the "could not be read" warning. The new work-tree entry point treats Err as "skip quietly". The message format! and GATE_REASON_PREFIX stay byte-identical. A gate finding joins the send-back as its own optional section (send_back_text_full), is not added to report_gaps, and if it survives the send-back the loop exits and the unchanged check_and_verify gate ends the job with today's message. dispatch appends a governing-decisions section to the producer prompt (unstored) built from the prediction commit's decision-links.toml and the planned paths, and prints nothing when the list is unreadable.

decisions.choice: Evaluate the gate in producer_loop on the work tree's change list; keep check_and_verify's gate unchanged as the backstop.
decisions.reason: The work directory, snapshot, send-back counter and invocation record exist only inside produce_and_verify. The candidate commit is base tree plus change list, so snapshot blob text equals the committed text and both verdicts agree. The backstop still serves resumed jobs, nested runs and any path that skips the loop, and it produces today's message when the second try still fails.

rejected.option: Send back from check_and_verify after the candidate commit
rejected.why: The work tree is gone and the candidate is already recorded and admitted; it would need a fresh snapshot and re-admission.

rejected.option: Move the gate into the loop only
rejected.why: Resumed jobs and nested runs would lose the check.

decisions.choice: Split unreconciled_decisions into a private builder `decision_gate(base, changed, read_candidate) -> Result<Option<String>, String>` with the single message format!, plus two callers. The commit caller `unreconciled_decisions` (same signature) maps Err to the existing warning line `warning: docs/decision-links.toml could not be read, so decisions are not checked: ...` and returns None. The new `unreconciled_in_snapshot` maps Err to None silently.

With the warning in the commit caller alone, the loop never prints it, so the count in governed_check_is_skipped_for_a_resume_at_the_verifier stays at 1, and the unreadable list sends no one back (producer runs once). Message text and prefix remain in one place, so the retry reader (reading.rs retry_findings) is unaffected.

risks.risk: Existing gate tests assert one producer run (tests.rs:2295, 2320) and the retry test asserts 2 prompts. The send-back makes these two and four.

risks.risk: The loop's verdict differs from the later gate's (a deleted docs file, a mode 160000 blob, a rename), sending back a candidate that then passes or missing one the gate fails.
risks.mitigation: A miss falls through to the unchanged gate at check_and_verify, which fails exactly as today. Blob read errors map to empty text, as the commit reader's missing-file case does. The criterion-1 test passes through both gates.

risks.risk: Cost: gated jobs that used to fail after one producer run now run a second one.
risks.mitigation: The unmet-criteria send-back already takes the same path, ReserveStage covers one send-back, agent_spec enforces the per-invocation producer_usd cap, and the shared budget keeps it to one.

risks.risk: A job sent back for criteria and then unreconciled gets no second send-back for the gate.
risks.mitigation: This is the requested shared budget. If the gate finds the problem on the first report, both are fixed in the same send-back; otherwise check_and_verify ends the job with today's message. The producer_loop doc comment says so.

risks.risk: The fake producer applies edits to the same work directory on the second call, so the scripted second candidate must not assume a fresh snapshot.
risks.mitigation: Existing replay send-back tests already rely on the persisting directory (tests.rs ~1872); reconciling_on_send_back adds edits only when the prompt contains '## Sent back'.

risks.risk: Appending the section changes the prompt of every governed job; if it were stored it would break brief_sha256.
risks.mitigation: It is appended in memory after the stored brief; tests.rs:489 and 690 pin the stored brief's hash.

risks.risk: A quiet skip in the loop on an unreadable list could hide the problem from the operator.
risks.mitigation: check_and_verify still runs the commit-based gate and prints the warning once, exactly as today.

Assert: producer count 2; the second prompt contains '## Sent back', GATE_REASON_PREFIX, 'D02 (README.md)' and '[[link]]'; the first prompt has no '## Sent back'; the job is not failed with the gate prefix, state Landed; verifier count 1; a UI line starting 'checks     ' and one 'producer   sent back: decisions not reconciled'.
